product.name: Mupler
product.one_liner: Your clients fill the data, we fill the USCIS forms.
product.positioning: Client intake automation built exclusively for U.S. immigration attorneys. Replaces confusing USCIS PDFs with simple branded web forms, then generates ready-to-file PDFs automatically.
product.audience: Solo immigration attorneys and small-to-mid-size immigration firms in the United States.
product.trial: Free 2-week trial, no credit card required.

pains: A single I-130 case takes dozens of back-and-forth emails just to finish basic intake.
Clients open a raw USCIS PDF, get confused, and either stall or return it half-filled.
Form I-864 (Affidavit of Support) is where family-based cases quietly stall for weeks.
Form I-130A produces some of the most error-prone client answers: address history, employment history.
Paralegal hours disappear into chasing missing fields instead of billable work.
Retyping the same client data into multiple forms invites typos that cost a filing.
Clients judge a firm's professionalism from the very first intake link they receive.
Every new client means re-sending the same forms from scratch.
Client portals that require signup add friction and get abandoned.
Immigration attorneys handle extremely sensitive personal data and carry ABA, CCPA and GLBA obligations.
features: USCIS-based forms library, updated within 5 days of a USCIS release.
Client-friendly web forms with plain-language hints instead of PDF jargon.
No client login or signup: a secure link opens straight in the browser.
Autosave, validation and conditional logic so clients cannot submit garbage.
One-click export to print-ready, correctly formatted PDFs plus supporting documents.
Your branding on the form: color themes, fonts, and white-label on higher tiers.
Client progress tracking so you know who is stuck and where.
Works on desktop, tablet and mobile, any modern browser.
End-to-end encryption, U.S.-based servers, U.S. privacy law compliance.
proof_points: Forms library updated within 5 days of USCIS releases.
Built for immigration law only, not a generic form builder.

voice.tone: Direct, practical, peer-to-peer. You are talking to a busy attorney, not running an ad.
do: Lead with a concrete, recognizable moment from immigration practice.
Use specific form numbers (I-130, I-130A, I-864) when relevant.
Sound like a practitioner who has felt the problem.
dont: No hype words: revolutionary, game-changer, seamless, unlock, supercharge, effortless.
No more than one hashtag, and only if it genuinely fits.
Never give legal advice or make claims about USCIS processing outcomes.
Do not promise approval rates, speed of adjudication, or anything USCIS controls.

Never imply that using Mupler satisfies, covers or discharges an attorney's own ethical, bar or confidentiality duties. Those stay with the attorney. Mupler is built to support them, nothing stronger.
Do not describe the product as compliant on the attorney's behalf. You may say the platform itself is built around ABA, CCPA and GLBA requirements.
No ALL CAPS, no clickbait teasers like 'you won't believe'.
Avoid stacking four short declarative sentences in a row. Vary sentence length or the post reads like it was assembled by a machine.
